notes: Read SKILL.md and references/bulk-audit-playbook.md, ecommerce-platform-patterns.md, http-status-codes.md, llm-crawler-handling.md, pre-migration-playbook.md, robots-txt-reference.md, technical-audit-example.md, technical-audit-templates.md in full. Audits crawlability, indexability, Core Web Vitals, mobile, HTTPS/security, URL structure, structured data and hreflang with /10 section scores and a P0/P1/P2 roadmap; includes bulk, e-commerce platform, AI-crawler robots.txt, and pre-migration playbooks.

Declares `allowed-tools: WebFetch` (SKILL.md:13) and treats fetched content as untrusted (SKILL.md:108). SKILL.md:102 gives a runnable read-only command `curl "https://crt.sh/?q=%25.<domain>&output=json"` (certificate-transparency subdomain lookup) and the W3C Nu validator URL — public, keyless, read-only lookups. SKILL.md:98,100,104 reference helpers (`robots.py`, `sitemap.py`, `crawl.py`, `onpage.py`, `psi.py`, `ledger.py`, `firecrawl.py`, and a gated `indexpush.py ... --key $INDEXNOW_KEY` / `--token $BAIDU_PUSH_TOKEN`, dry-run by default) under `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/connectors/`; none ship with this skill, so the audit falls back to WebFetch and user-provided reports (SKILL.md:96,139). Rated medium for the shell curl to a third-party service and the described credentialed index push; acceptable because the curl is a pinned read-only public query on the user's own domain, the push is opt-in and unavailable standalone, and no destructive or state-changing command is executed by the agent.

Writes audit summaries, a pre-migration baseline, a redirect-map CSV and post-migration diffs under memory/ (SKILL.md:149; pre-migration-playbook.md:21,31,76,104-106) — the main save is after asking. Migration cutover steps (robots.txt changes, sitemap submission, removing staging noindex; pre-migration-playbook.md:89-94) are a checklist for the user, not agent actions. Non-shipping optional pointers: ../../../references/skill-contract.md (handoff shape), ../../../CONNECTORS.md, ../../../SECURITY.md, ../../../scripts/connectors/README.md. Paid tools (~~web crawler, ~~page speed tool, ~~CDN) are optional.
